VM and syscall fuzz harnesses for execution setup, run, and effect capture.

# Purpose
This C file implements fuzzing entry points for the Firedancer Solana runtime VM and syscall execution path. It builds execution contexts from serialized test input, sets up transaction and instruction state, loads account data into VM input regions, and then runs either a full VM instruction execution or a single syscall call. The file also defines a syscall lookup helper and a no-op syscall stub used during VM fuzzing so that syscall effects do not depend on external runtime behavior.

The main functions, [`fd_solfuzz_vm_interp_run`](<#fd_solfuzz_vm_interp_run>) and [`fd_solfuzz_syscall_run`](<#fd_solfuzz_syscall_run>), prepare the VM, configure memory regions such as `rodata`, heap, and stack, register syscalls, and collect execution results into protobuf-backed output structures. These results include error codes, compute unit state, register values, frame count, logs, and copied memory contents. The code is intended for test and fuzz harness use, not for general program execution, and it depends on internal executor, loader, VM, and test utility interfaces.
